protocol: Build each backend's source-calibrated quasicircular cap state and advance exactly one fixed RKF45 step. Compare the final 4-vector and its local derivative with respect to chi1 across Torch autograd, JAX JVP, and centered finite difference. This measures one fixed-time component, not a cap-to-requested-frequency crossing.
interpretation: One high-spin, near-cap, fixed-mesh FP64 CPU component. Excludes adaptive controller, event time, requested-frequency map, whole waveform, domain coverage, and release qualification.
